meta.source: RKKA 1:100 000 sheet of 1941, region R33 (roadgraph node N10), traced by guided waypoints snapped to the line work
meta.crs: DEM-lattice metres (x east, y north), as roads_1941.json
meta.ends_field: ends = [start, end]: "border" = cut exactly on the region border (x 12288 or y 8192), "block_edge" = on the block edge (x 18432 or y 2048), "junction:<name>" = shares the exact vertex with that line, null = other (village street end / dead end, see deadends.json)
